purpose: Explain measured versus predicted vehicle energy and force over a bounded historical window, including missing signals, contradictions, unknown intervals and session boundaries.
primaryGoal: Inspect all eleven physics domains for the workspace-selected vehicle without mistaking unknown residuals or incomplete telemetry for measured zero or complete coverage.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-gated historical query; physicsLedgerKeys.window includes scope; AbortSignal forwarded to request. scopedPath emits snake_case vehicle_id/start/end. Handler validates positive vehicle and ordered dates, defaults to 24 hours, permits up to 366 days and delegates solving to the service. Root payload is returned; readPhysicsLedger also understands older wrapped responses. Service, database coverage and solver correctness not audited.

URL hours/start/end; presets 6 and 24 hours; default 24. Anchor captured once at mount. Valid explicit windows up to 24 hours accepted; invalid or longer URLs fall back to anchored preset. Choosing a preset updates hours/start/end and preserves other search parameters.

dataSources.endpoint: useVehicles dependency; fleet endpoint not independently traced
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id, stored selection and first-fleet fallback; known-fleet reconciliation. Page adds no local vehicle picker and returns NoVehicleSelected when effective ID is null.

Historical trust state preserves returned data after refresh failure. Panels pass SI Wh, W, m, m/s, Celsius, kPa and seconds to display helpers; force remains N and mass kg. Raw arrays and cache values are not converted. Formatting implementations were not exhaustively traced.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Thermal, range, tires and dynamics wrap a self-surfaced OperationalBrief in another GlassPanel with the same domain title and honesty text. Thermal repeats correlation below its brief; tires repeats imbalance below its brief.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Review existing brief/card composition with the shared owner; reduce repeated chrome using supported composition while preserving every metric, specialist explanation, status, scope and Review details action.

issues.detail: mobileColumns excludes predicted energy and sample count; UnknownPanel excludes interval end. DataTable applies hidden md:table-cell to excluded keys. These callers supply neither mobilePresentation nor expanded full-detail content, so the excluded evidence is not rendered in the mobile table surface.
issues.fix: Use the existing opt-in DataTable mobile presentation/detail contract or a non-lossy scroll strategy; keep every column accessible, existing table IDs, row ordering, pagination and loaded-row export semantics.

issues.detail: The inspected chart wrapper exposes an image name and visual tooltip but no equivalent source-data table/text interaction. MotionCharts supplies numeric plots without a page-level accessible data alternative.
issues.fix: Coordinate with the existing chart owner on a keyboard-reachable numeric alternative retaining timestamp, power, speed, force and null gaps; reuse the existing chart/table pipeline rather than creating another chart library.

accessibility.unverified: Keyboard navigation, tooltip interaction, drawer focus/trapping/restoration, screen-reader output, actual contrast, forced colors, reduced motion and touch-target sizes were not exercised. The Area renderer does not explicitly set isAnimationActive; actual motion/preferences compatibility remains unknown, not a verified failure.

states.loading: Initial state mounts twelve named PendingPanels shells with h-32 Skeleton and aria-busy.
states.empty: Absent nested domains show titled domain-specific unknown/empty content; nullable arrays normalize with asList or Array.isArray. No selected vehicle uses existing onboarding guidance.
states.error: fatalError renders QueryError/refetch; retained refresh failures keep the complete ledger and StaleRefreshWarning.
states.staleOffline: Shared deriveDataState preserves payload and marks failed/paused refresh stale. Ledger transport trust is distinct from solver domain unknown flags.

issues.detail: A fatal request failure with no ledger renders QueryError and twelve PendingPanels empty messages claiming No ledger samples in this window. Failed acquisition does not establish an empty measurement result. An initially paused query also remains initial and shows loading skeletons.
issues.fix: Pass the existing source state to persistent shells and distinguish acquisition failure/paused prerequisite from successful no-evidence results; preserve QueryError retry, all twelve shells and retained-data rendering.

issues.detail: Null or absent unknown_intervals is normalized to an empty list and described as Full coverage: no gaps in this window. The same claim appears if the ledger is truncated, despite the explicit oldest-prefix warning. Empty supplied intervals alone do not establish complete requested-window coverage.
issues.fix: Retain null-versus-empty knowledge and truncation context; use a coverage-neutral no-returned-interval message unless the source explicitly establishes complete requested-window coverage. Do not synthesize zero hours or invent a backend completeness flag.

issues.detail: Top-level trust is derived only from query transport and never receives partial options. A truncated ledger therefore has an ok/Source returned summary alongside its sample-cap badge, while domain LedgerEvidenceBrief correctly downgrades truncation to partial.
issues.fix: Keep transport freshness and solver completeness distinct but consistently described using the current data-trust contract and explicit source evidence. Preserve contradictions and missing-signal badges; do not reinterpret individual unknown fields as total failure.

visualIssues.detail: Three local fixed hex chart colors bypass the current chart palette/theme preference owner. These colors are not evidence of neon by themselves, but they cannot follow saved palettes and theme semantics.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing chart-palette owner at presentation time; keep power/speed/force series distinguishable and preserve explicit saved chart preferences. Do not invent a new palette or remove series.

visualIssues.detail: Marker rows use raw text-sm and a raw muted span rather than role typography; most neighboring panels already use Text/Caption/PanelTitle.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing typography roles with semantic element overrides; preserve ordered-list semantics, exact dates and source marker identities.

architectureIssues.detail: The dated ledger owns a separate 6/24-hour page selector via useAnalysisWindow; /tesla-physics/ledger is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS. Header range ownership is therefore disabled while the vehicle picker remains enabled. The local helper ignores workspace from/to state and anchors its fallback once per mount.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate a workspace-owner migration using existing useRangeState and route registration, passing both bounds through the existing typed hook. Preserve bookmarked hours/start/end interpretation, bounded solver semantics, copy-link behavior and the existing 6/24-hour investigations; do not silently broaden or lose specialist windows.

priority.rationale: Correct false coverage and failed-versus-empty claims first; preserve mobile evidence and reconcile workspace range ownership before cosmetic flattening. Palette and repeated chrome are secondary.

competingImplementations.fix: Resolve with the existing workspace owner and preserve specialist investigation links; no second range engine.
